slide_1.first_textbox: Program governance required weekly operational checkpoints, measurable remediation targets, and explicit ownership for unresolved handoff failures.
slide_1.second_textbox: Multiple regional support teams rolled out an AI-assisted incident workflow to classify inbound issues, identify repeated failure patterns, and prioritize interventions before service-level breaches occurred. Leaders then consolidated response-time trends, escalation quality indicators, and workload forecasts into one operating cadence so supervisors could rebalance staffing, tighten routing policy, and reduce backlog volatility under sustained demand.
